title: Enforce one single comment per list per device (comment generator only)

requirements.text: Add backend enforcement so that, for the single-comment generator flow only, the same device can generate at most one comment per comment list; subsequent attempts for the same (device, listName) must fail with a clear error.

quotes: Only one comment per list per device
only in the comment generator feature
the button not work or error message anything you like

acceptanceCriteria: A new/updated backend API is available for the frontend to request a single comment while providing a device identifier.
When a device requests a single comment for a listName the first time, the backend returns a comment successfully (assuming the list has unused comments).
When the same device requests another single comment for the same listName, the backend rejects the request with an error message indicating the one-per-device-per-list restriction.
Requests for different listNames from the same device are still allowed (subject to list availability).
Bulk comment generation behavior is unchanged.

requirements.text: Update the Customer View single comment generator UI to implement 'one comment per list per device' by generating/persisting a device identifier in browser local storage, using it when calling the backend single-comment API, and disabling the single-generate button (or showing an English error) when the device has already generated a single comment for the selected list.

quotes: Only one comment per list per device
only in the comment generator feature
the button not work or error message anything you like

acceptanceCriteria: On first successful generation for a selected list, the UI stores that the current device has used that list for single generation and prevents further single generations for that list on the same browser/device.

If the backend rejects the request due to the one-per-device-per-list rule (e.g., after clearing local storage or on a second tab), the UI shows a clear English error message and the single-generate button ends up disabled for that list.
The disable/error behavior applies to all users (no admin/user exceptions).
Bulk comment generation UI/behavior remains unchanged.

requirements.text: If the backend uses stable persisted state for comment generator data, add/extend the migration to initialize any new persisted structure needed to track per-(device, listName) single-generation usage without breaking existing deployments.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing deployed state (comment lists, bulk key, etc.) continues to load after upgrade.
New usage-tracking state (if persisted) is initialized to an empty value on upgrade.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Implement the one-comment-per-list-per-device restriction only for the single comment generator flow (do not apply it to bulk generation, admin tools, live list checking, image upload, or chat).
All user-facing text introduced or modified for this change must be in English.
nonGoals: Do not implement cross-browser or cross-device fingerprinting beyond a locally-stored device identifier.
Do not add third-party authentication or external databases/services to support device tracking.
Do not change the admin access code flow or other unrelated UI sections.
